name: Mutiny
summary: Mutiny is an AI-driven personalization platform for B2B marketers, making it easy to tailor website content and campaigns to individual visitors for better conversion.
description: Mutiny is an AI-driven personalization platform for B2B marketers, making it easy to tailor website content and campaigns to individual visitors for better conversion. Be the one buyers remember. Join the frontier of how the best enterprise sales teams operate. Real-time website personalization: Tailors content for each visitor. Segmented campaigns: Target specific business audiences. A/B testing: Experiment with different website messages. Analytics dashboard: Monitor conversion and engagement rates.

features: Real-time website personalization: Tailors content for each visitor.
Segmented campaigns: Target specific business audiences.

howToUse.title: Request a Demo & Onboarding
howToUse.description: Sign up for a demo or contact Mutiny for onboarding. Their team will guide you through integration and best practices.

howToUse.title: Add Mutiny to Your Website
howToUse.description: Install the Mutiny code snippet to enable real-time personalization and data collection.

howToUse.title: Set Up Audiences and Segments
howToUse.description: Define business audiences and create segments based on firmographics, behavior, or CRM data.

howToUse.title: Personalize Content and Launch Campaigns
howToUse.description: Build personalized website experiences, run A/B tests, and launch segmented campaigns.

howToUse.title: Analyze Impact
howToUse.description: Use Mutiny’s analytics dashboard to track engagement, conversions, and campaign effectiveness.

features_fr: Personnalisation du site Web en temps réel : adapte le contenu à chaque visiteur.
Campagnes segmentées : ciblez des publics professionnels spécifiques.
Tests A/B : expérimentez différents messages de sites Web.
Tableau de bord d'analyse : surveillez les taux de conversion et d'engagement.
